review_type: Independent adversarial source review of the raw parameter grid edit path (cell_value, ReadOnly, Out of range, Commit Params) against ConfigRawParams.cs, plus the Flight Plan screen against FlightPlanner.cs
verdict: REJECTED for exact-clone parity (Score: 6.5/10). The typed-text path of the params grid now follows Params_CellValueChanged closely: RC/HS _REV 0 to -1, comma as decimal point, an arithmetic expression evaluator, NaN/infinity rejection, the ReadOnly message, and the Out of range Yes/No modal. Commit Params now shows its message as a modal. But the grid has three other ways to change a value (the Options combo, the bitmask window, and the Set to default context menu). All three write the edit directly and skip the ReadOnly and range checks, which C# never skips because every control there writes through the Value cell. Escape commits a typed edit instead of cancelling it. The Options column has no NumericUpDown for ranged parameters. Commit Params reports success without waiting for the ack. Several C# message boxes are routed to Toasts::info, which only logs, so the user never sees them. On Flight Plan, the context menu is close to complete, but there is no undo history and no Ctrl+Z/O/S or Ctrl+Shift+W/R/F hotkeys. Write and Write Fast are the same action and skip every pre-write check C# runs (absolute-alt confirm, invalid home, grid errors, Low alt on WP#, zero-alt warning). Read does not confirm before clearing the list. Changing the command does not apply the C# defaults for TAKEOFF, LAND, DO_DIGICAM_CONTROL or UNKNOWN. Tests: 209 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored, 0 warnings. Mobile file access is still limited to POSIX paths.

scores.scale: Adversarial parity evaluation on a 0-10 exact-clone scale. 10/10 requires indistinguishable feature and UI/UX parity with Mission Planner C# on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iOS.

verified_improvements: Typed-value parsing follows Params_CellValueChanged: cell_value() (config.rs:594-606) converts RC*/HS*_REV '0' to '-1', treats ',' as a decimal point, evaluates an arithmetic expression and rejects NaN/infinity, matching ConfigRawParams.cs:460-478. Covered by cell_values_follow_cellvaluechanged (config.rs:566-581).

The check order on the typed path is parse, then ReadOnly, then range (config.rs:1610-1626), as in ConfigRawParams.cs:474-516. The ReadOnly text matches C#: '<name> is marked as ReadOnly, and will not be changed' (config.rs:1616 vs ConfigRawParams.cs:488-491).

There is now an 'Out of range' Yes/No modal with the C# text '<name> value is out of range. Do you want to continue?' (config.rs:1224-1251). Answering No leaves the cell at its old value, matching ConfigRawParams.cs:499-516.

R43-02 partly resolved: Commit Params now shows 'Parameters committed to non-volatile memory' as a modal message box (config.rs:1001; Toasts::error renders the CustomMessageBox modal at app.rs:1116-1135), matching ConfigRawParams.cs:1105. The failure path is still missing (see R44-07).
Disconnecting during a parameter write now marks the in-flight writes as failed (config.rs:901-904, 1220-1222), with a test at config.rs:584-591.

findings.subsystem: Flight Plan: write/read validation and confirmation
evidence: C# BUT_write_Click (FlightPlanner.cs:645-710) asks 'Absolute Alt is selected are you sure?' when the alt mode is Absolute, rejects an invalid home ('Your home location is invalid'), rejects non-numeric cells ('There are errors in your mission'), blocks with 'Low alt on WP#n' when Alt < TXT_altwarn for anything except TAKEOFF/LAND/RTL, and runs checkZeroAlts (FlightPlanner.cs:8555+) for Plane/Copter. It then shows the 'Sending WP's' ProgressReporterDialogue (712-724).
C# but_writewpfast_Click (FlightPlanner.cs:1883-1899+) is a separate path: it says 'Only available for missions' for fence/rally and repeats the same validation.
C# BUT_read_Click (FlightPlanner.cs:606-637) asks 'This will clear your existing points, Continue?' (OK/Cancel) when rows exist, then shows the 'Receiving WP's' progress dialog.

Rust flight_plan.rs:471-483 ORs Write and Write Fast into one `write` flag and sends LinkCommand::WriteMission directly, with none of these checks or dialogs. Read sends ReadMission and overwrites the list without asking. A grep for 'Low alt on WP', 'errors in your mission', 'Absolute Alt is selected', 'clear your existing points' and 'ZeroAlt' in crates/mp-app/src finds nothing.
findings.impact: A mission with a below-minimum or zero-altitude waypoint uploads silently, which C# blocks. One click on Read wipes an unsaved plan. Write Fast is a duplicate button.
findings.required_fix: Add a shared pre-write validator that mirrors FlightPlanner.cs:647-710 and checkZeroAlts, with the C# texts and Yes/No/OK boxes. Add the Read confirm from FlightPlanner.cs:608-621. Make Write Fast a separate partial-write path that refuses non-mission types with 'Only available for missions'. Add a modal progress dialog for Sending/Receiving WP's. Add tests for each blocking case.

findings.subsystem: Flight Plan: undo history and hotkeys
evidence: C# keeps List<List<Locationwp>> history (FlightPlanner.cs:112), fills it through updateUndoBuffer (FlightPlanner.cs:1038-1074, called at 19 sites including delete/up/down at 2247, 2258, 2267), and FlightPlanner.ProcessCmdKey (FlightPlanner.cs:345-413) binds Ctrl+Z to undo, Ctrl+O to load the WP file, Ctrl+S to save it, Ctrl+Shift+F to Write Fast, Ctrl+Shift+W to Write and Ctrl+Shift+R to Read.

Rust has no undo in flight_plan.rs or flight_plan/*.rs (grep -i undo finds nothing). Global Ctrl+Z is bound to the camera test (app.rs:972-983) on every screen, so pressing Ctrl+Z in Plan sends camera COMMAND_LONGs instead of undoing.
findings.impact: A deleted or moved waypoint cannot be restored. Muscle-memory shortcuts do something else or nothing.
findings.required_fix: Add a history stack to the planner, pushed before every grid/map mutation that C# calls updateUndoBuffer for. When View::FlightPlan is active and no text field has focus, handle Ctrl+Z/O/S and Ctrl+Shift+F/W/R in the planner before MainV2-level hotkeys run, matching WinForms ProcessCmdKey precedence.

findings.subsystem: Params grid: ReadOnly and range checks bypassed by non-text editors
evidence: In C#, every editor writes into the Value cell, so Params_CellValueChanged (ConfigRawParams.cs:454-533) runs the ReadOnly and range checks for each one: bitmask ValueChanged sets Cells[Value].Value (1192-1196), the options combo sets it in SelectedIndexChanged (1262-1266), and the NumericUpDown sets it on TextChanged (1302-1306).
Rust's Options-column combo writes self.edits directly (config.rs:1664-1683) with no ReadOnly check.
The bitmask window writes self.edits directly (config.rs:1705-1736), with no ReadOnly check.
The 'Set to default' context menu sets v and changed=true (config.rs:1530-1536, 1562-1568, 1630-1633), with no ReadOnly or range check.
Only the typed path (1610-1626) and the value-cell combo (1589-1590) check read_only.
findings.impact: A parameter marked ReadOnly in the metadata can be queued and written to the autopilot through three UI paths that C# guards.
findings.required_fix: Send every value change (typed text, value combo, Options combo, bitmask, set-to-default) through one function equivalent to Params_CellValueChanged: ReadOnly box, then range Yes/No, then queue the edit. Add tests that the Options combo and bitmask window cannot edit a read_only param.

findings.subsystem: Params grid: Options column controls and Value cell editor
evidence: C# Params_RowEnter (ConfigRawParams.cs:1270-1316) puts a NumericUpDown in the Options cell for ranged numeric params. Its Minimum and Maximum come from the metadata range, its Increment from metadata or range/1000 rounded to a power of 10, and its DecimalPlaces from the increment.
C#'s Value column is always a plain text cell. The enum dropdown exists only in the Options column (1207-1266).
Rust renders the Options cell of a ranged param as static text 'lo hi' (config.rs:1650-1651, 1684-1686). There is no spinner.
Rust turns the Value cell itself into a ComboBox when meta.values is non-empty (config.rs:1580-1603), so an enum param cannot be typed into the Value cell as it can in C#.
findings.impact: Ranged parameters lose the bounded spin control operators use. Enum parameters behave differently from Mission Planner in the Value column.
findings.required_fix: Add a NumericUpDown-equivalent in the Options cell of the current row, with the C# min, max, increment, decimal places and clamping, routed through the R44-03 funnel. Keep the Value cell a text editor for every parameter type.

findings.subsystem: Params grid: Escape commits instead of cancelling
evidence: In C#, CellBeginEdit saves cellEditValue (ConfigRawParams.cs:1114-1117), and the DataGridView cancels an edit on Escape, so CellValueChanged never fires.

Rust commits whenever the TextEdit loses focus (config.rs:1609-1628). egui's TextEdit gives up focus on Escape, so Escape runs cell_value() on the typed buffer and queues it. flight_plan.rs:760-762 already checks key_pressed(Escape) to cancel, so the fix pattern exists in the codebase.
findings.impact: An operator who presses Escape to back out of a typo gets the typo queued as a change, or an Out of range prompt.
findings.required_fix: In the config.rs value editor, check ui.input(|i| i.key_pressed(Key::Escape)) when focus is lost and drop the buffer. Add a UI-harness test like the flight_plan one at flight_plan.rs:1498-1499.

findings.subsystem: Message boxes routed to the log-only Toasts::info
evidence: Toasts::info only calls log::info! (app.rs:154-156). Only Toasts::error reaches the CustomMessageBox modal (app.rs:159-165, 1116-1135). There are 30 info call sites.

Write Params success: C# shows '{n} parameters successfully saved.' titled 'Saved' (ConfigRawParams.cs:369). Rust config.rs:877 calls toasts.info('Parameters successfully saved.'), which is invisible and has no count.
No changes: C# shows 'No parameters were changed.' titled 'No changes' (ConfigRawParams.cs:371). Rust config.rs:969 calls toasts.info('No changes'), which is invisible.
Parameter count changed while unarmed: C# shows a message box (ConfigRawParams.cs:389). Rust config.rs:916 calls info, which is invisible.
Flight Plan Area: C# shows 'Area: N m2 / Acre / Hectare / sqf' titled 'Area' (FlightPlanner.cs:1758-1760). Rust flight_plan/menu.rs:204 calls info with different text, which is invisible.
findings.impact: Clicking Write Params, or Write Params with nothing changed, gives no visible result. The Area tool shows nothing.
findings.required_fix: Audit every toasts.info call against its C# counterpart. Where C# calls CustomMessageBox.Show, use the modal with the exact C# text and title (add a title parameter to Toasts). Keep info only where C# merely logs.

evidence: C# BUT_commitToFlash_Click (ConfigRawParams.cs:1093-1107) calls doCommand, which waits for COMMAND_ACK and throws TimeoutException('Timeout on read - doCommand') (MAVLinkInterface.cs:2829). On an exception it shows 'Invalid command' and returns. Only on success does it show 'Parameters committed to non-volatile memory'.
Rust config.rs:997-1002 sends LinkCommand::CommandLong{245} and shows the success box immediately. A grep for CommandAck in config.rs finds nothing.
findings.impact: The operator is told the parameters are in flash even when the autopilot rejected the command or never answered.
findings.required_fix: Track the pending PREFLIGHT_STORAGE command and show the success box only on a MAV_RESULT_ACCEPTED LinkEvent::CommandAck for 245. Show 'Invalid command' on timeout or rejection.

findings.subsystem: Flight Plan grid: command change defaults and Alt Warn behaviour
evidence: C# Commands_SelectionChangeCommitted (FlightPlanner.cs:2485-2538) applies defaults when the command changes. TAKEOFF sets Alt to TXT_DefaultAlt if it was 0 and zeroes Lat/Lon. LAND sets Alt to 0. DO_DIGICAM_CONTROL sets Param1 to 1 if it was 0. UNKNOWN prompts with an InputBox ('Mavlink ID', 'Please enter the command ID').
Rust flight_plan.rs:684-702 only sets w.id = id. Its combo items use selectable_label(false, ...), so the current command is never highlighted.
C# Alt Warn is a write-time block ('Low alt on WP#', FlightPlanner.cs:695-705) comparing the grid Alt with TXT_altwarn. C# paints a cell red only for 'Invalid Home or wp Alt' (1227-1228).
Rust instead paints the Alt cell red from SRTM terrain clearance (flight_plan.rs:662-676) and never blocks the write.
findings.impact: A TAKEOFF row can keep a 0 alt and stale lat/lon. Custom command IDs cannot be entered. Alt Warn behaves differently from Mission Planner.
findings.required_fix: Port Commands_SelectionChangeCommitted's per-command defaults and the UNKNOWN InputBox. Highlight the current command in the combo. Make Alt Warn a write-time check with the C# message (shared with R44-01) and drop the SRTM-based red cell.

findings.subsystem: Flight Plan grid: distance column and cell editors
evidence: C# setgradanddistandaz (FlightPlanner.cs:6597-6624) shows Dist as the 3D slant distance sqrt(d^2+h^2)*multiplierdist, formatted '0.0'.
Rust flight_plan.rs:812-815 shows the horizontal distance, formatted '{:.0}'.
The C# Param1-4/Lat/Lon/Alt cells are DataGridView text cells. Rust uses egui DragValue (flight_plan.rs:704-780), so a click-drag on a cell changes lat/lon/alt.
findings.impact: Displayed leg distances differ from Mission Planner. Waypoints can be nudged by accident with the mouse.
findings.required_fix: Compute Dist as slant distance with one decimal. Replace the DragValue cells with click-to-edit text cells that commit on Enter or focus loss and cancel on Escape, with the 'Invalid Lat/Long, please fix' box (FlightPlanner.cs:2296-2309).

findings.subsystem: Params grid: smaller divergences and non-C# additions
evidence: The ReadOnly box is titled 'Mission Planner' (app.rs:1122). C# titles it 'ReadOnly' (ConfigRawParams.cs:490).

An unparsable entry is added to self.failed (config.rs:1612-1614), so the tooltip reads '[Status: Set Failed on Autopilot]' (config.rs:1508-1509). C# only paints the cell red (ConfigRawParams.cs:526-529).

The expression evaluator treats '%' as modulo (config.rs:648-649) and has no functions. C# uses mXparser 4.3.3 (MissionPlanner.Utilities.csproj:47), whose modulo operator is '#' and which supports functions such as sqrt and sin.

Additions that C# does not have: a Reboot Now/Later prompt that sends a reboot (config.rs:1321-1351; C# shows an OK-only box at ConfigRawParams.cs:374-377), a '⚠️ Note' line and '[Reboot Required]' tags in the write confirm (config.rs:1272, 1280, 1288), and 'Set to default'/'Revert changes' context menus (config.rs:1530-1575).
findings.impact: Small visual and behavioural differences from Mission Planner. Extra controls a Mission Planner user would not recognise.
findings.required_fix: Pass the C# titles to the modal. Track parse errors separately from write failures. Match mXparser operator semantics, or at least reject '%'. Remove or setting-gate the non-C# additions.

findings.subsystem: Mobile storage access (carried over from R43-01)
evidence: platform.rs:63-90 document_roots() still lists hard-coded POSIX paths (/sdcard/Download, /sdcard/Documents on Android). There is no SAF or UIDocumentPicker bridge (no ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT, UIDocumentPicker or jni in platform.rs).
On mobile, the Flight Plan 'Inject Custom Map' button is a silent no-op: the rfd call is cfg-gated out (flight_plan.rs:423-438) and there is no fallback or message.
findings.impact: On Android 11+ and iOS, users cannot reach files in shared storage or cloud providers. Some buttons do nothing.
findings.required_fix: Add Android SAF intents (ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT, ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT, ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT_TREE) through JNI and an iOS UIDocumentPickerViewController bridge, and route every picker, including Inject Custom Map, through them.

next_concrete_task: Port the Flight Plan pre-write validator and read confirm (FlightPlanner.cs:606-710, 1883-1899, checkZeroAlts at 8555) into flight_plan.rs:471-483 with the exact C# texts, and split Write Fast from Write. After that, send every params-grid value change through one Params_CellValueChanged-equivalent function so the Options combo, bitmask window and Set to default can no longer skip the ReadOnly and range checks (R44-03).
not_verified: No CI run exists for 198fbf2, so the Android, iOS and macOS builds of this head are unverified.
No flight controller or SITL was connected. COMMAND_ACK handling for PREFLIGHT_STORAGE and the param write round-trip were checked by reading the source only.
The Escape-commits-edit behaviour (R44-05) is inferred from egui's TextEdit giving up focus on Escape and the missing Escape check at config.rs:1609. It was not reproduced in a running app.
mXparser 4.3.3 operator semantics ('#' for modulo, '%' not modulo) are from the library's documented operator set. The C# evaluator was not executed.
Flight Data was only spot-checked (the Arm/Disarm confirmation and Force Arm flow match FlightData.cs:1043-1089 at flight_data.rs:281-285 and 1114-1119). It was not reviewed in full.
Pixel-level layout and font rendering were not compared with WinForms.
